from dataclasses import dataclass, field


@dataclass
class EvalCase:
    input: str
    expected: str
    tags: list = field(default_factory=list)


dataset = [
    EvalCase("I absolutely love this product, it works perfectly!", "positive", ["clear", "product"]),
    EvalCase("This was the worst experience I have ever had.", "negative", ["clear", "service"]),
    EvalCase("The package arrived on Tuesday.", "neutral", ["factual"]),
    EvalCase("Not bad at all, I was pleasantly surprised.", "positive", ["negation", "edge-case"]),
    EvalCase("I wouldn't recommend this to anyone; it broke after a day.", "negative", ["negation", "product"]),
    EvalCase("The meeting is scheduled for 3 PM in room 204.", "neutral", ["factual", "short"]),
]

for case in dataset:
    print(case)
